meta.name: team-routing
meta.description: Detect domain from context and find appropriate team member

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据上下文自动识别领域并找到合适的团队成员
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要根据任务内容快速找到负责的同事。
copy.tagline_en: Detect domain from context and find the right team member
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find the right colleague based on task content.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能从分支名或文件路径中提取关键词，查询 Notion 数据库找到对应领域，再分配一个可用的团队成员作为审查员，最后输出分配结果。
howto.when: 当用户推送 PR（自动分配审查员）或初始化代码审查流程（显示领域上下文）时触发。

say.text: 为这个 PR 分配审查员。
say.note: Claude 分析分支名和文件，自动分配可用审查员。

say.text: 检查当前分支属于哪个领域。
say.note: Claude 从分支名提取关键词并查询领域数据库。

say.text: 根据变更文件路径查找领域负责人。
say.note: Claude 匹配文件路径模式并查询团队成员可用性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude extracts keywords from branch names or file paths, queries a Notion database to find the relevant domain, then assigns an available team member as reviewer and outputs the assignment result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user pushes a PR (auto-assign reviewer) or initializes a code review flow (show domain context).

say_en.text: Assign a reviewer for this PR.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes branch and files, then assigns an available reviewer.

say_en.text: Check which domain the current branch belongs to.
say_en.note: Claude extracts keywords from branch name and queries domain database.

say_en.text: Find the domain owner based on changed file paths.
say_en.note: Claude matches file path patterns and queries team member availability.
